changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: Adds facility_id to hivst_result. Column is added nullable first so existing rows can be backfilled, then locked to NOT NULL once every row has a value. Backfill source: hivst_encounter.facility_id via hivst_result.encounter_id.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hivst_result r SET facility_id = e.facility_id FROM hivst_encounter e WHERE r.encounter_id = e.id AND r.facility_id IS NULL;

changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: Adds facility_id to hts_ict_contact. Column is added nullable first so existing rows can be backfilled from hts_ict_encounter.facility_id via ict_encounter_id. NOT NULL is only enforced if every row was successfully backfilled — rows whose parent hts_ict_encounter no longer exists (orphaned FK) are left with a null facility_id rather than failing the whole install, and a NOTICE is logged for visibility.

changeSet.author: Emmanuel Nnajiofor
changeSet.comment: Data fix: hts_encounter.observation->>'finalHivTestResult' has some rows with the legacy/incorrect value "Suspected Acute Infection" (case varies due to data quality issues — e.g. "suspected acute infection", "SUSPECTED ACUTE INFECTION"). This clears that value to an empty string, keeping the finalHivTestResult key in the JSON but emptying it out, since it's no longer a valid final result value.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter SET observation = jsonb_set(observation, '{finalHivTestResult}', '""'::jsonb, false) WHERE observation IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(observation, 'finalHivTestResult') AND lower(trim(observation->>'finalHivTestResult')) = 'suspected acute infection';
